title: Power discom is still heavily reliant on Tamil Nadu government’s financial support

title: IIT Palakkad researchers develop sensors for faster heparin monitoring
content: Accurate dosing of heparin, an anticoagulant used in cardiac surgery, dialysis etc., is important because too little of it can lead to clotting, while too much can cause excessive bleeding

title: Tanker hit by projectile near Strait of Hormuz was operating in ‘dark mode’
content: Photos of the ship from September 13 indicate that the engine room was attacked and damaged by the projectile; the tanker had 25 crew members on board: 14 Indian and 11 Pakistani nationals.

title: Udhayanidhi condemns TVK-led govt. over attempt to ‘paralyse’ High Level Committee on Union-State Relations
content: The Committee was constituted during the previous M.K. Stalin-led DMK govt.; the LoP in T.N. Assembly claimed that the present govt. has created a situation in which the research scholars working on the Committee’s second report were unable to continue their work

title: Rescued baby orangutans get health check-up after one develops fever
content: The orangutans, generally found in the wild in Borneo and Sumatra, were rescued from a forest in Odisha's Balasore district on September 8, triggering a probe into possible trafficking of these animals

title: Supreme Court nod for Kerala High Court to continue execution proceedings in Kashi Math case
content: Kerala High Court decision of August 2026 allows Kashi Matadhipati Samyamindra Tirtha to continue execution proceedings for recovery of gold, silver ornaments and paraphernalia belonging to Kashi Math Samsthan from Raghavendra Tirtha

title: CPI(M)’s Keralam meet condemns ED action against Pinarayi, Veena, Riyas
content: In a resolution passed on the concluding day of the meeting on Tuesday, the party says the “political witch-hunt” being conducted by the ED“ will be strongly resisted both legally and politically

title: Maratha quota stir: Jarange Patil leaves for Mumbai as police deny nod for protest
content: His arrival on September 16 will be the third protest staged in Mumbai for Marathi reservation in last three years.

title: India-U.S. armies begin ‘Yudh Abhyas’ with focus on technology, interoperability
content: A key focus of the exercise is the use of technology in battlefield operations, with participating troops training in the employment of drones and autonomous systems for surveillance and reconnaissance

title: Merchants to be charged 0.4% for UPI transactions over ₹2,000; small vendors exempt
content: Ministry of Finance says person-to-person transactions, which will also be exempt, constitute 70% of the value of total UPI transactions; according to the Ministry, only 4% of merchant transactions will attract the charge

title: Rural jobs scheme shows modest uptick in August,  but trails 2025 MGNREGA levels
content: July and August show lower employment generation year-on-year as cumulative persondays fall 32%, from 29.78 crore to 20.21 crore; 60-day pause in agricultural activity led to dip in jobs, say Ministry officials

title: Sports Minister announces task force to assess F1 revival in India
content: The Task Force also has representation from the Department of Tourism and Commerce, among others and will include representatives from the Uttar Pradesh and Maharshtra Government

title: Habitual offender arrested after chase in Thiruvananthapuram
content: The accused, identified as Suresh alias Jambulingam Suresh, who hails from Balaramapuram, had allegedly been evading arrest after a case involving an attack on a woman and her daughter on August 20

title: Former IPS officer issues clarification on remarks about Ram Temple CEO selection
content: The Temple Trust has been forced to issue a detailed clarification amid calls for a review of the entire process and concern over favoritism flagged by other retired senior officials and applicants

title: NH 66, NH 544 safety lapses in Thrissur will be fixed in a month: NHAI
content: Review meeting assesses progress of construction, maintenance, upgrades and safety measures on the two highways; lighting and warning signs to be installed in two weeks

title: Relief of residents as removal of chemical-laced soil begins in village in Keralam
content: The hazardous chemical waste from the now-defunct Binani Zinc Limited in Ernakulam district was illegally transported and dumped across private lands in Eriyad, a coastal village in Thrissur district, a few months ago, under the guise of regular soil for land filling, raising environmental concerns among the public. A meeting chaired by RDO decided to remove the entire material within two days

title: Narrower margin for error in Census second phase, training vital, Registrar General says
content: In a letter sent to all States, Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India Mritunjay Kumar Narayan asks for the integration of gender sensitisation in training programme for enumerators, with emphasis on respectful interaction, accurate recording, and strict avoidance of assumptions or bias

title: Resident of care home steps into a new life
content: Shalini, who grew up under the protective care of Government After Care Home for Adolescent Girls at Injavila, Kollam, marries Sudheesh of  Anchalummoodu

content: The changes are part of the corrective steps intended by the extended State committee meeting held under the monitoring of the central leadership led by general secretary M.A. Baby and other Polit Bureau members

title: Backward Classes group raises concern over challenges to caste census
content: National BC Dal president Dundra Kumaraswamy said variations arising from regional nomenclature, sub-caste identities, local usage, pronunciation and spelling could result in multiple entries for what may, in social terms, represent the same community

title: Delhi court grants three weeks interim bail to Swatantra Bhardwaj to observe his conduct
content: The court added that if the complainant or the investigating officer finds him breaching any of the conditions of the interim bail, they are at liberty to bring the same to the court’s notice without waiting for the next date, so that the interim bail may be reviewed or recalled

title: KWA to re-tender 5 MLD STP as no bidder qualifies; Work begins on 27-km sewage pipeline in Kochi
content: The sewerage treatment project includes three components — an STP and two sewage pipeline networks of 27 km and 17 km

title: Two Kuki women killed in Manipur
content: Attack by armed assailants less than 48 hours after two separate strikes killing four people, including a couple, on Sunday; in protest, Kuki-Zo Council says Kuki victims will not be buried till further notice

title: Brahmotsavams: Chief Minister Naidu offers ‘silk vastrams’ to Tirumala temple
content: He carries the pair of ‘vastrams’ on his head and makes the customary offering on behalf of the State government

title: People should come forward to guide CPI(M): Baby
content: Party national general secretary says people should point out its mistakes, aberrations, and confusions at a  public rally marking culmination of CPI(M)’s extended State committee meet in Kozhikode

title: 'Our father being slowly killed': Imran Khan's sons accuse Asim Munir of vendetta
content: Imran Khan's sons publicly claim that army chief Asim Munir is engaging in a personal vendetta against their father. They voice serious concerns over Khan's prison conditions, labeling them as torture. For more than six months, the sons have been unable to contact their father, and they worry about his neglected eye condition, which could lead to significant vision impairment. However, the Pakistani government dismisses these allegations as unfounded propaganda.

title: Omar praises India’s foreign policy over Brics mention of Pahalgam, slams Centre on UCC
content: Jammu and Kashmir' chief minister Omar Abdullah commended India’s diplomatic achievements at the recent Brics summit. He highlighted the group's unified condemnation of the Pahalgam terrorist attack. Furthermore, Abdullah expressed concerns about the central government's strategy in implementing the Uniform Civil Code and asserted that such pivotal legislation ought to be decided by Parliament, rather than through isolated state actions that circumvent legislative norms.

title: Samson's 57 off 22 establishes his role of preferred opener as India seal series
content: Sanju Samson showcased his incredible skills, leading India to a triumphant T20 series win against Afghanistan with a blistering fifty-seven runs in just twenty-two balls. He was well-supported by Abhishek Sharma, who added thirty-eight not out. Meanwhile, the impressive bowling from Nitish Kumar Reddy eased the coaching staff’s worries, while the stellar performance of Samson and Sharma indicates a tough challenge ahead for the younger players.

title: 'Should be laughed out': T Mobile CFO on Musk's 'Starlink plan' for mobile industry
content: T-Mobile's CFO Peter Osvaldik stated Starlink Mobile is not a serious wireless threat. He criticized SpaceX's changing strategy and proposed infrastructure plans. Satellites face physical limitations in urban environments, blocking signals. SpaceX's plan for numerous small cell stations is deemed impractical by T-Mobile. Therefore, Starlink's challenge to traditional telecom operators is not currently convincing.

title: Fee on UPI payments above Rs 2,000: Who pays and what changes for you
content: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is essentially a fee that a merchant incurs when accepting payments for goods or services through credit or debit cards. It is important to note that person-to-person transactions will continue to be free with no MDR applicable.

title: His flat faced water leaks for 8 years; court orders neighbour to allow repairs
content: This water leakage problem between two neighbours in a housing society turned into an eight-year legal battle, with the Maharashtra Co-operative Appellate Court eventually directing the owner of the first-floor flat to allow repairs in his home.

title: Neighbours over-trimmed trees for lake view; judge orders $34,064 damages
content: A British Columbia woman allowed her neighbours to trim some trees in 2021, but they cut far more than she had permitted to improve their view of Shuswap Lake. A court found the neighbours liable for trespass and ordered them to pay $34,064 for replacement trees, a shade structure and two air conditioning units.

title: Bel-Air founder’s 1928 estate bought for $5.5m now asks $32.5 million
content: Alphonzo Bell's stunning 1928 Bel-Air estate has hit the market with a hefty price tag of $32.5 million. After purchasing the mansion for $5.5 million over a decade ago, the owner has meticulously completed a five-year restoration project. This exquisite Spanish-style residence harmonizes original architectural details with modern luxuries, creating a perfect sanctuary that embodies both historical charm and contemporary elegance.

title: Formerly enslaved man founded Illinois town; 191 years later, land joins NPS
content: The Hampshire House in Manhattan has seen its unfinished penthouse sell for $6.765 million, a staggering reduction of 83% from its original listing of $40 million. This raw attic space demanded substantial work to become livable. After years of challenges and strategic efforts, it was sold through an online auction, highlighting the complexities of luxury real estate dealings in New York City.

title: Tasmania creates trout-free havens for native fish with only 6,000 left
content: Conservation workers are building barriers and clearing waterways to save native Swan galaxias.  This tiny fish faces extinction after brown trout were introduced over 160 years ago.  Natural barriers helped some populations survive, but droughts and floods pose risks.  Teams are creating trout-free refuges and moving fish to safe, isolated catchments.  These efforts balance angling tradition with crucial species recovery for native wildlife.

title: Lalbaugcha Raja: How a broken market and a vow created Mumbai’s iconic Ganpati
content: Lalbaugcha Raja started from a community's heartfelt desire for a thriving marketplace. This wish materialized into a public Ganesha idol in 1934, granting countless devotees their aspirations. The Kambli family has been sculpting the Raja's iconic visage for three generations. With millions waiting for darshan, this enduring emblem of collective faith continues to inspire hope across generations.

title: Sanju Samson joins Rohit Sharma, KL Rahul in India's elite club
content: The Kerala batter was a key player in India's T20 World Cup triumph, but his form has been inconsistent since then. He had scored only 33 runs in four innings before the Afghanistan series. With youngster Vaibhav Sooryavanshi also pushing for a place, Samson needed a strong performance. The upcoming Asian Games also added to the importance of his form.

title: ‘Aapko jaanta hi kaun hai’: Biker Sia hits back at gym owner’s ‘victim card’ remark
content: Shivani Chauhan at the center of a Gurgaon road-rage incident has spoken out against the accused gym owner. She stated that her identity was not widely known before the media reported the incident. The woman, who previously contested an election, is now taking a strong stance on the matter. She detailed her alleged harassment and chase, believing it could have been fatal.

title: Rafael Nadal vs Maria Francisca Perello net worth: Who is richer in 2026?
content: Rafael Nadal and Maria Francisca Perello have built a financially successful household in different ways. Nadal’s fortune is still considerably larger, thanks to tennis prize money, endorsements, investments and businesses built during and after his playing career. Perello has taken a lower-profile professional route, including work related to the Rafa Nadal Foundation, while supporting the family’s broader business and philanthropic pursuits.

title: Holly Rowe responds to Arch Manning: What did she say after his AI joke?
content: Holly Rowe has responded after former ESPN colleague Cindy Brunson defended her following Arch Manning’s comments about a fake AI video. Manning called the clip “hilarious” after Texas beat Ohio State. Brunson criticized those who laughed and praised Rowe for helping women in sports media. Rowe thanked Brunson publicly, keeping her response brief while the debate continued online.

title: How fish has BJP's plate full in West Bengal
content: Amidst the ongoing conversation regarding dietary customs within Hinduism during Durga Puja, chief minister Suvendu Adhikari engaged in prayer and enjoyed traditional bhog. He asserted that faith-based dietary choices should remain personal, asserting his own commitment to sattvik eating on designated days while also accepting fish and goat meat as temple prasad, demonstrating a multicultural approach.

title: Pittsburgh’s last steel mill closed in 1998; 178 acres are being transformed
content: After decades of lying vacant, Pittsburgh’s former steel mill site Hazelwood Green is finally seeing major redevelopment. Since 2022, around 700,000 square feet has been developed or is under construction, including Carnegie Mellon’s robotics centre, Pitt’s BioForge facility, housing, parks and a football field. More technology, retail and housing projects are planned across the 178-acre riverfront site.

title: New York covered Lake George with 700 mats; 97% of invasive clams died
content: In 2011, Lake George took significant action against its invasive Asian clam issue by implementing a large-scale benthic barrier treatment, which successfully eliminated ninety-seven percent of clams in a five-acre area. However, by 2019, these clams made a comeback, with twenty-seven sites identified. Consequently, efforts have shifted to monitoring their spread and impact on the ecosystem.

title: Gurgaon hit-and-run: Stalking, attempt to murder charges slapped on Kalyan Bainsla
content: A gym owner was arrested for ramming his car into a woman biker.  The accused allegedly made indecent comments and attempted to kill the victim.  Police apprehended the suspect in Rajasthan after a two-day search operation.  He was booked under attempt-to-murder and stalking charges following the incident.  The victim stated she was targeted due to her gender and could have died.

title: Inside Gisele Bündchen’s $9.1m Florida ranch with 10 horse stalls
content: Supermodel Gisele Bündchen has made a stunning investment in Florida, acquiring a vast 7.5-acre equestrian estate priced at $9.1 million. This impressive property includes ten horse stalls and even a full-sized soccer field, catering to her passion for horses and outdoor activities. With nine bedrooms and significant renovations complete, this estate adds to her expanding real estate portfolio, perfect for luxurious living amidst nature.

title: San Francisco mall may get 6 basketball courts, 8 volleyball courts and school
content: A bold proposal seeks to convert San Francisco Centre into a vibrant sports complex, featuring state-of-the-art basketball and volleyball courts alongside a dedicated sports high school. Retail and dining options will continue to serve the community, drawing in visitors for both recreation and education. This innovative plan has the potential to breathe new life into the once-bustling downtown mall.

title: Roger Federer’s $8.1m mansion: Why did he build a new Lake Zurich home?
content: Roger Federer’s former Wollerau glass mansion near Lake Zurich was built as a private family home and was reportedly worth about $8.1 million. He listed it for 5.4 million Swiss francs in 2017 and sold it in 2018. Federer later focused on his much larger Rapperswil-Jona waterfront estate, where construction has faced several delays and disputes.

title: Travis Kelce retirement: What did he say after breaking records vs Broncos?
content: Travis Kelce, the Kansas City Chiefs’ tight end, has opened up about the retirement rumors and has cleared the air on it in the new season.

title: Harry Potter star Johnny Flynn says private schools should be ‘burnt to the ground’
content: Harry Potter star Johnny Flynn has opened up about his traumatic experience at Winchester’s Pilgrims’ School, where he was bullied after entering boarding school at seven. The actor developed nervous tics and later underwent therapy, which helped him understand “boarding school syndrome”. Flynn said he does not think private schools should exist.

title: India’s exports to US, China surge in August amid stronger global trade
content: India's merchandise exports to the US and China saw significant growth in August. Shipments to the US increased by over twenty-one percent while China saw a fifty-two percent rise. Overall exports climbed by more than twenty-six percent, driven by key sectors. Imports also grew, with electronics and crude oil shipments increasing substantially. This performance narrowed the merchandise trade deficit to its lowest in five months.

title: FDA suspends licences of Mumbai's iconic Cafe Mondegar, 3 others over safety violations
content: The Maharashtra FDA has taken decisive action by suspending licenses of well-known restaurants and food joints due to severe hygiene breaches. Recent inspections uncovered alarming failures in food storage and sanitation. During a focused drive for the festive season in Mumbai and Maharashtra, thousands of kilograms of questionable food have been confiscated, prompting legal proceedings against several non-compliant food business operators.

title: IndiGo Agartala-Delhi flight diverted to Lucknow after smoke warning in cargo area
content: An IndiGo flight from Agartala to Delhi diverted to Lucknow after a smoke warning. The aircraft landed safely with all 103 passengers and six crew members unharmed. Airport emergency teams were deployed as a precautionary measure following the alert. This incident follows a similar diversion of an Air India Express flight days earlier. Both aircraft landed safely, and no smoke was found during inspections.

title: Canada will be ‘stronger, more resilient, more independent’ after US trade war: Carney
content: Canada aims for economic resilience and independence from trade disputes.  New tax incentives will encourage private investment in Canadian businesses.  The nation is also seeking deeper economic ties with the European Union.  This strategy aims to reduce dependence on the United States market.  Canada remains open to future mutually beneficial agreements with Washington.

title: Rs 3.25 lakh meant for father went to wrong account; Karnataka HC orders refund
content: The court passed the order after hearing a petition filed by the woman who said she had intended to transfer the money to her father but inadvertently sent it to another account. The account belonged to M/s Standard Engineering Works and, according to the petitioner's case, was dormant.

title: Merchants to now pay fees on UPI transactions above Rs 2,000 from Oct 15
content: The MDR will be effective from October 15, 2026. . This timeline gives acquiring banks, payment aggregators, fintech applications, and corporate accounting platforms adequate lead time to update their software engines and billing systems.

title: Olympiad mess! Indian chess players get rooms after AICF intervention in Samarkand
content: Upon their arrival in Samarkand, India's chess team faced a frustrating delay concerning hotel accommodations due to miscommunication from the local organizing committee. Fortunately, All India Chess Federation president Nitin Narang stepped in and reached out to FIDE to resolve the accommodation issue. Now, players are comfortably settled in individual rooms, while coaches share rooms.

title: Why China’s housing market remains weak despite new government support measures
content: China's new home prices declined again in August, continuing a prolonged property downturn. Major cities showed signs of stabilization, while smaller markets still faced price drops. Government measures aim to boost buyer confidence and developer funding models. Property sales and construction remain weak, contributing to economic slowdown. The market shows no sustained recovery despite recent policy interventions.

title: Australia sank 60 concrete fish boxes; 3 years later, fish species rose to 60+
content: Launched in 2013, purpose-designed artificial reefs were deployed along Western Australia's coast, leading to a remarkable transformation of the seafloor. In a span of three years, fish species surged from a mere dozen to an impressive sixty. These artificial structures not only enrich marine biodiversity but also provide excellent recreational fishing sites, exemplifying the project's effectiveness in promoting both marine life and community involvement.

title: 5,800 New York acres once planned for homes are headed to public auction
content: A large Adirondack Park property, planned for extensive residential development, is now headed for a public foreclosure auction. This project, which promised hundreds of homes and a ski resort, faced significant legal challenges. After years of litigation and mortgage defaults, the land's ownership became entangled in foreclosure proceedings. An investor is owed millions, and the county also seeks significant property tax payments.

title: Why Matthew McConaughey made son Levi wait until 15 for social media
content: Matthew McConaughey has made the thoughtful decision to restrict his son Levi's access to social media until he's fifteen. He strongly believes in allowing children, including his ten-year-old daughter who will also forgo a phone, to cultivate their own identity before engaging online. Instead of browsing, he encourages them to embrace reading and songwriting, thereby valuing genuine experiences and personal growth.

title: Gurgaon hit-and-run accused injured after 'trying to escape' police custody
content: In a dramatic turn, the accused in the Golf Course Road hit-and-run case sustained injuries while fleeing from police custody. Kalyan Singh Bainsla stumbled during his escape attempt and was swiftly apprehended again. The police managed to locate both Bainsla and his cousin Lavish in Rajasthan after the incident concerning a female biker.

title: "With A Heavy Heart": Emotional Post By Techie's Wife After Oracle Layoff
content: After 12 years at Oracle, Pooja Sahu said her husband, Sourabh, found himself among those impacted by the technology giant's latest layoffs.

title: US Redirects Military Aid From Europe, Middle East To Allies In Latin America
content: The State Department on Tuesday notified Congress that it will reprogram $52 million in foreign military financing from Slovakia, North Macedonia, Tunisia and Iraq to Panama, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia.

title: "Extinction Not A Credible Risk": AI Researcher Sara Hooker To NDTV
content: Human extinction is one of the biggest concerns raised by AI leaders over the past week. Sara Hooker shares why she is not concerned.

title: "Reckless": EU After Russian Ship Fires Flares At Danish Military Helicopter
content: Denmark and Russia blamed each other for the flares fired at a Danish military helicopter monitoring a Russian frigate on Monday.

title: 'World Is Suffering Enough': Qatar Warns Against Bab al-Mandab Closure
content: Qatar foreign ministry official Ibrahim Al Hashmi said closure of the southern entrance to the Red Sea would be catastrophic for the world.

title: Noise From Plant Powering Musk's AI Data Centres Keeps Mississippi Locals Awake
content: Gas turbines at the plant have been running all day to provide power to xAI's Colossus data centre in Memphis. Residents say the noise sounds like a jet engine and has made it difficult for them to sleep.

title: Explosion In Bengal's Rejinagar Ahead Of Bypolls, Cops Recover Bombs
content: Locals said a loud explosion was heard in Naopukuria under Beldanga police station late in the evening, following which the area was covered with smoke. People rushed towards a nearby water body from where the sound was heard, but none was found.

title: AIUDF Chief Badruddin Ajmal To Contest Lok Sabha Bypoll From Assam's Nagaon
content: The AIUDF had earlier indicated that Rezaul Karim Sarkar could be its nominee, but eventually opted to put its supremo directly into the electoral contest.

content: On Monday, the Supreme Court dealt Trump a major blow ahead of November's midterm elections when it denied his request to lift an order halting his plan to limit mail-in voting.

content: The subject arose during a contentious Senate Judiciary Committee hearing in which Patel clashed with Democrats over his firing of agents who participated in investigations of President Donald Trump

title: US Military Destroys 2 Small Iranian Boats Trying To Steal A Drone
content: Iranian state media reported Monday that a pair of fishing boats came under attack in Hormozgan province on Iran's southern coast and that several fishermen were reported missing, citing a provincial official.

title: Diplomatic Ties Still Strained, India Yet To Approve Next Bangladesh Envoy
content: Dhaka wants to send Foreign Secretary Asad Alam Siam to New Delhi for the post. But before that can happen, India needs to grant what's called an agreement, which is basically formal sign-off from the host country.

title: Meta India Head Summoned For 3rd Time Over Child Abuse Advertisements
content: The case stems from a BBC Eye media report that said Instagram had been running advertisements promoting what appeared to be child sexual abuse material in India.

content: The accused, Karamveer Singh, a resident of Bahadur Ke village in Ludhiana, was arrested by the AGTF team at Indira Gandhi International (IGI) Airport, New Delhi, upon his arrival

content: The flight 6E6504 landed safely at Lucknow Airport at 6.29 pm with 103 passengers and 6 crew members, airport authorities said.

content: The biggest highlight of iOS 27 is a more capable version of Siri, and users are also getting a Siri App for the first time.

title: Mumbai's Iconic Cafe Mondegar Loses Licence Over Food Safety, Hygiene Lapses
content: Located in Colaba, Mondegar faced food safety inspections on Saturday, during which serious deficiencies emerged in safety and hygiene.

title: Arrest Not Enough, He Needs To Be Punished: Biker Sia On Hit-And-Run Driver
content: Asked about Kalyan Bainsla claiming she was misrepresenting the incident to gain online traction, Sia said she contested the municipal election in 2022, "so a lot of people know me".

title: In 3 Weeks, Bengal Does U-Turn On Akshaya Patra Providing Mid-Day Meals
content: The government had assigned the "Akshaya Patra Foundation" for the mid-day meal service in the government-run schools in Kolkata. The proposal was if they succeed, they will extend it across the districts.

title: Trump's Name Must Be Kept Off Kennedy Centre Building, US Judge Rules
content: The Trump-aligned board at the Kennedy Centre voted in August to inscribe the president's name on the venue's facade so it would read "The John F Kennedy Centre for the Performing Arts Restored and Renovated By President Donald J Trump."

title: J&K Police bust LeT module; 3 held with IED
content:
Representational image

JAMMU: Police in J&K said they have busted an LeT network in Pir Panjal region with the arrest of three suspects and seizure of IED . Separately, police on Monday attached immovable property belonging to a suspected terror handler in Rajouri district. According to police, the arrested have been identified as Zakir Hussain, Mohammed Azam and Mohammed Mushtaq, all from Rajouri. Preliminary investigation has revealed they provided logistical support, safe transit and other ground-level assistance to terrorists.

title: Child rights panel again summons Meta India MD, head over sexual abuse material case

title: Meet Meera Ramaswami, who turned grandmother’s fall into patented device
content: Meera Ramaswami, Founder of cargility, developed a portable mobility aid . she watched her grandmother lose her balance during a moment that should have been routine . her grandmother became less willing to travel, and she began thinking about how a small loss of stability could lead to isolation .

title: Saudi Arabia issues brief danger alerts for Mecca, Jeddah, Taif amid Houthi escalation
content:
Mecca, the holiest site for nearly 2 billion Muslims, received its first-ever live emergency missile & drone warning

Saudi Arabia’s civil defence on Tuesday issued brief alerts warning of potential danger in Mecca, Jeddah and Taif amid an escalation in attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels from Yemen. The alert for Mecca, home to Islam’s holiest site, was the first such warning during the latest escalation, but authorities said the danger had cleared minutes later. The alerts came a day after ballistic missiles and drones launched from Yemen injured 13 people in southern Saudi Arabia, according to AFP. The Directorate of Saudi Civil Defense posted on X: "The danger has passed in Mecca City. For your safety, continue following Civil Defense instructions and avoid gathering and filming. In case of emergency, call (911)."

End of Article
